name: Oil and Gas Sector
source_file: GRI 11_ Oil and Gas Sector 2021 V1.1.pdf
purpose: GRI 11: Oil and Gas Sector 2021 V1.1 provides information for organizations in the oil and gas sector about their likely material topics. These topics are likely to be material for organizations in the oil and gas sector on the basis of the sector’s most significant impacts on the economy, environment, and people, including on their human rights.
